checks.what: every stride of every speed and side is kept: one row per column of each raw array
the authors' average curve equals the mean of the raw stride columns for every joint, variable, speed and side
the authors' stdev curve equals the sample SD of the raw stride columns
no empty samples in the raw arrays
equal numbers of ipsilateral and contralateral strides per speed
K2 participants walked at 0.4-0.8 m/s and K3 at 0.6-1.4 m/s (all but one subject complete)
TF02 walked 4 of the 5 speeds (could not walk the last speed, 0.8 m/s)
total walking speeds over subjects (17 x 5 + 4)

differences: The paper reports no gait values, only participant and design numbers, so the published checks are the Table 1 participant data, the K-level split and the speed design. The deposit's README says a manuscript was still in revision when the data were posted; the paper is the Scientific Data article above.
